fan_speed_max.description: Maximum allowed fan speed (typically PWM duty cycle or RPM).

temp_max.description: Maximum temperature threshold (°C) before critical action is triggered.

voltage_tolerance.description: Allowed voltage deviation percentage (±%) from nominal values.

monitor_enabled.description: If true, enable automatic hardware monitoring (fans, temperatures, voltages).

sensors.description: List of sensors to monitor (e.g., temperature, voltage, current).

name.description: Descriptive name for the sensor (e.g., 'CPU Temp', 'GPU Voltage').

label.description: Custom label to display instead of the default sensor name.

alert.description: Whether alerts should be generated when value exceeds limits (true/false).

fans.description: List of fans to monitor and control.

name.description: Human-readable name for the fan (e.g., 'System Fan', 'CPU Fan').

min.description: Minimum allowed fan speed (RPM or PWM value).

max.description: Maximum allowed fan speed (RPM or PWM value).
